title: FAST-7B: Guarded Replenishment Policy and Queue Coverage Contract

sourcePlanning.title: Plan backlog replenishment after major backlog depletion alert

triggerPolicy.cycleRule: A replenishment cycle can issue at most 3 approved slices, then must honor 240-minute cooldown unless an explicit override checkpoint is approved.

queueCoverageObjective.approach: Restore planned coverage toward 10 tasks via approved slices that are independently executable and dedupe-safe.

measuredBy.successCondition: Depth trend returns toward 10 without violating issuance or dedupe guardrails.

explicitNonGoals: Do not create filler tasks solely to inflate queue counts.
Do not bypass implementation, review, or validator gates to accelerate issuance.
Do not issue unbounded or speculative slices outside approved replenishment scope.

checkpoints.name: slice-scope-approval
checkpoints.evidence: Each candidate slice maps to objective-tree branch and defines acceptance signal.

checkpoints.name: post-cycle-safety-review
checkpoints.evidence: Cooldown compliance, dedupe outcomes, and queue-depth movement are recorded.

revisitTriggersForIrreversibleDecisions: Two consecutive cycles fail to improve queue depth toward target.
A requested irreversible workflow change alters dedupe or approval boundaries.
Any override request that changes cooldown or issuance bounds.

onOpenTaskConflict.requiredEscalation: Open FAST task collision must be resolved or superseded before new issuance.

onRecentRunCollision.requiredEscalation: Recent planning run collision requires owner review before retries.

auditRequirements: Record conflict type, blocking artifact ID, and decision owner.
Persist a no-op cycle outcome when issuance is blocked by dedupe safeguards.

boundaries: Trigger ingestion and dedupe checks are preconditions and cannot be bypassed by issuance logic.
Issuance logic operates only on approved slices and bounded cycle rules.
Queue coverage measurement is read-only and informs next-cycle approvals.
interfaces: Input: backlog depletion trigger artifact with dedupe evidence.
Output: bounded issuance decisions, checkpoint records, and queue coverage telemetry.
risks: Over-issuance during unstable periods can mask root-cause failures.
False-positive dedupe collisions can stall recovery if escalation ownership is unclear.
implementationReadyDecisions: Cooldown fixed at 240 minutes per cycle.
Maximum issuance fixed at 3 tickets per cycle.
Coverage objective fixed at restoring planned queue depth toward 10 tasks.
